title: 活動上認識新朋友
subtitle: 12 句英文，交流活動不再只會發名片

lines.say: Hello. I am Giulia. I work in marketing. Here is my card. Do you have a job for me?
lines.zh: 你好，我是 Giulia，我做行銷。這是我的名片。你有工作給我嗎？

lines.say: Oh… em… I'm just going to get a drink. Excuse me.
lines.zh: 喔……呃……我去拿杯飲料，失陪一下。

lines.say: This is Giulia. She's brilliant at her job. But she went straight to: give me a job. And he ran.
lines.zh: 這是 Giulia，她工作能力超強。但她一開口就是「給我工作」，對方就跑了。

lines.say: Networking isn't selling yourself. It's being curious about other people.
lines.zh: 經營人脈不是推銷自己，而是對別人好奇。

board.cta: 活動上認識新朋友・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today, Giulia will learn twelve sentences for any networking event.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天 Giulia 要學任何交流活動都能用的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today, Giulia will learn twelve sentences for any networking event.

lines.say: Breaking the ice, talking about work, making a connection, and leaving with a contact.
lines.zh: 打破沉默、聊工作、建立連結，最後帶著聯絡方式離開。

lines.say: Part one: break the ice.
lines.zh: 第一段：破冰。

lines.say: The first minute is about the event, not about jobs.
lines.zh: 第一分鐘聊活動本身，不要聊工作。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Giulia.
scenes.meaning: 嗨，我們應該還沒見過，我是 Giulia
scenes.note: I don't think we've met ＝ 我們應該還沒見過

lines.say: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Giulia.
This is the easiest way to walk up to a stranger. No excuse needed.
lines.zh: 這是走向陌生人最簡單的方法，不需要任何理由。

lines.say: Say your name, hold out your hand, and smile.
lines.zh: 說名字、伸出手、微笑。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Giulia.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: So, what brings you here tonight?
scenes.note: What brings you here? ＝ 你怎麼會來這裡？

lines.say: Then ask the perfect first question.
lines.zh: 接著問一個完美的第一個問題。

lines.say: So, what brings you here tonight?
What brings you here? is open. They can talk about work, a friend, or the free wine!
lines.zh: What brings you here? 很開放，對方可以聊工作、朋友，或免費的紅酒！

lines.say: Everyone at the event has an answer.
lines.zh: 活動上每個人都答得出來。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: So, what brings you here tonight?

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: How do you know the organisers?

lines.say: And then find the link between you.
lines.zh: 接著找出你們之間的關聯。

lines.say: How do you know the organisers?
This question often shows you know the same people. Instant connection!
lines.zh: 這個問題常會發現你們認識同樣的人，馬上有連結！

lines.say: Organisers, with an S in Irish and British English.
lines.zh: 愛爾蘭和英式英文拼 organisers，用 s。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: How do you know the organisers?
Part two: talk about work.
lines.zh: 第二段：聊工作。

lines.say: Ask first, listen properly, and then talk about yourself.
lines.zh: 先問，好好聽，再談自己。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: What line of work are you in?

lines.say: What line of work are you in?
This is a softer way to say: what's your job?
lines.zh: 這是「你做什麼工作？」比較柔和的說法。

lines.say: It sounds curious, not like a job interview.
lines.zh: 聽起來是好奇，不像在面試。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: What line of work are you in?

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: That sounds fascinating. How did you get into that?
scenes.meaning: 聽起來很有意思，你怎麼會進這一行的？
scenes.note: get into ＝ 開始做、進入（某行業）

lines.say: Then show real interest.
lines.zh: 接著表現出真心的興趣。

lines.say: That sounds fascinating. How did you get into that?
How did you get into that? asks for their story. Everyone has one.
lines.zh: How did you get into that? 是問對方的故事，每個人都有。

lines.say: People remember the person who listened, not the person who talked.
lines.zh: 大家記得的是傾聽的人，不是講最多的人。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: That sounds fascinating. How did you get into that?

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: I work in marketing, mostly on the digital side.
scenes.meaning: 我做行銷，主要負責數位這塊
scenes.note: on the ... side ＝ 負責……那一塊

lines.say: When they ask you back, keep it short.
lines.zh: 對方反問你時，簡短回答。

lines.say: I work in marketing, mostly on the digital side.
One sentence: your field, and the part you do. That's it.
lines.zh: 一句話：你的領域，加上你負責的部分，就這樣。

lines.say: If they want more, they'll ask. And that's when it gets interesting.
lines.zh: 對方想知道更多就會問，那才是有趣的開始。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I work in marketing, mostly on the digital side.
Let's watch Giulia try again.
lines.zh: 我們看 Giulia 再試一次。

lines.say: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Giulia.
lines.zh: 嗨，我們應該還沒見過，我是 Giulia。

lines.say: Sipho. Nice to meet you.
lines.zh: 我是 Sipho，很高興認識你。

lines.say: So, what brings you here tonight?
lines.zh: 那你今晚怎麼會來？

lines.say: My company is one of the sponsors. I'm in software.
lines.zh: 我們公司是贊助商之一，我做軟體。

lines.say: That sounds fascinating. How did you get into that?
lines.zh: 聽起來很有意思，你怎麼會進這一行的？

lines.say: And now he's talking, and she's listening. Perfect.
lines.zh: 現在換他說，她在聽。完美。

lines.say: Part three: make a real connection.
lines.zh: 第三段：建立真正的連結。

lines.say: The best networkers help first, and ask later.
lines.zh: 最會經營人脈的人，先幫忙，之後才開口。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: You should talk to my colleague. She works on exactly that.
scenes.meaning: 你應該跟我同事聊聊，她做的就是這個
scenes.note: exactly that ＝ 正好就是這個

lines.say: You should talk to my colleague. She works on exactly that.
Offering an introduction is the best gift at any event.
lines.zh: 主動介紹人脈是活動上最好的禮物。

lines.say: Now they owe you one, and they'll remember you.
lines.zh: 現在對方欠你一份人情，而且會記得你。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: You should talk to my colleague. She works on exactly that.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: I'd love to pick your brain about it some time.
scenes.meaning: 我很想找時間向你請教一下
scenes.note: pick someone's brain ＝ 向某人請教

lines.say: Then ask for advice, not a job.
lines.zh: 接著請教意見，而不是要工作。

lines.say: I'd love to pick your brain about it some time.
Pick your brain means ask you for ideas and advice. It's a compliment: you're an expert.
lines.zh: pick your brain 是向你請教點子和建議，這是讚美：你是專家。

lines.say: People say yes to advice much more than to: give me a job.
lines.zh: 比起「給我工作」，大家更容易答應給建議。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I'd love to pick your brain about it some time.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: Are you on LinkedIn? I'll send you a request.
scenes.meaning: 你有 LinkedIn 嗎？我加你
scenes.note: send a request ＝ 送出（好友）邀請

lines.say: And get a way to stay in contact.
lines.zh: 再拿到之後聯絡的方式。

lines.say: Are you on LinkedIn? I'll send you a request.
Much easier than business cards these days.
lines.zh: 現在比交換名片方便多了。

lines.say: Do it right there, on your phone, so you don't forget.
lines.zh: 當場用手機加，免得忘記。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Are you on LinkedIn? I'll send you a request.

scenes.title: Leave and follow up
scenes.sub: 離開和後續：讓人記住你

lines.say: Part four: leave, and follow up.
lines.zh: 第四段：離開，然後後續聯絡。

lines.say: Don't stay with one person all night. And don't disappear afterwards.
lines.zh: 不要整晚黏著同一個人，事後也不要消失。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: I won't keep you. I'm sure there are lots of people you want to see.
scenes.meaning: 不耽誤你了，你一定還有很多人想見
scenes.note: I won't keep you ＝ 不耽誤你了

lines.say: I won't keep you. I'm sure there are lots of people you want to see.
I won't keep you is a kind way to end the chat.
lines.zh: I won't keep you 是結束聊天的體貼說法。

lines.say: It gives both of you the freedom to meet other people.
lines.zh: 讓你們兩個都能自由去認識其他人。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I won't keep you. I'm sure there are lots of people you want to see.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: It was great to meet you. Let's stay in touch.
scenes.meaning: 很高興認識你，我們保持聯絡
scenes.note: stay in touch ＝ 保持聯絡

lines.say: Then say goodbye properly.
lines.zh: 接著好好道別。

lines.say: It was great to meet you. Let's stay in touch.
Let's stay in touch means: this isn't the end.
lines.zh: Let's stay in touch 是「這不是結束」。

lines.say: Shake hands again. Same smile as the beginning.
lines.zh: 再握一次手，跟一開始一樣的笑容。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: It was great to meet you. Let's stay in touch.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: Great to meet you last night. As promised, here's the link I mentioned.
scenes.meaning: 昨晚很高興認識你，照約定附上我提到的連結
scenes.note: As promised ＝ 照約定、如我所說

lines.say: And the next day, send a short message.
lines.zh: 隔天，傳一則簡短的訊息。

lines.say: Great to meet you last night. As promised, here's the link I mentioned.
Send it within twenty-four hours, while they still remember your face.
lines.zh: 二十四小時內傳，趁對方還記得你的臉。

lines.say: As promised shows you keep your word. That's what people remember.
lines.zh: As promised 表示你說到做到，這才是別人會記住的。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Great to meet you last night. As promised, here's the link I mentioned.
I work with a lot of marketing teams, actually.
lines.zh: 其實我跟很多行銷團隊合作。

lines.say: Really? I'd love to pick your brain about it some time.
lines.zh: 真的嗎？我很想找時間向你請教一下。

lines.say: Sure. And you should talk to my colleague, Aoife. She works on exactly that.
lines.zh: 當然。你也應該跟我同事 Aoife 聊聊，她做的就是這個。

lines.say: That would be brilliant. Are you on LinkedIn? I'll send you a request.
lines.zh: 那太好了。你有 LinkedIn 嗎？我加你。

lines.say: Anyway, I won't keep you. It was great to meet you. Let's stay in touch.
lines.zh: 好了，不耽誤你了。很高興認識你，我們保持聯絡。

lines.say: A new contact, and an introduction. That's a good night's networking.
lines.zh: 一個新人脈，加一個引薦。這就是成功的交流之夜。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：人脈的兩句

lines.say: One more thing! In Ireland, everyone seems to know everyone. Two phrases for that.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！在愛爾蘭，好像每個人都互相認識。教你兩句相關的話。

board.kicker: When you know the same people

lines.say: When you find out you have a friend in common, say this.
lines.zh: 發現你們有共同朋友時，就這樣說。

lines.say: Small world!
In Ireland, you'll say this a lot. Two people in a room always know the same cousin.
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭你會常說這句。房間裡隨便兩個人一定認識同一個表親。

board.kicker: When you're asked about a person

lines.say: And when you can connect two people, offer this.
lines.zh: 可以幫兩個人牽線時，就這樣說。

lines.say: I'll put you in touch.
Put you in touch means introduce you, usually by email. The Irish do it all the time.
lines.zh: put you in touch 是幫你們介紹，通常是寫 email。愛爾蘭人超常這樣做。

lines.say: I'll put you in touch.

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：一場完整的交流

lines.say: Now the whole conversation, from hello to follow-up. Say Giulia's lines!
lines.zh: 現在把整段對話從打招呼到後續演一遍。跟著唸 Giulia 的台詞！

lines.say: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Giulia. How do you know the organisers?
lines.zh: 嗨，我們應該還沒見過，我是 Giulia。你怎麼認識主辦人的？

lines.say: I used to work with Ciara. And you?
lines.zh: 我以前跟 Ciara 一起工作。你呢？

lines.say: She's my flatmate's sister! Small world! So, what line of work are you in?
lines.zh: 她是我室友的姊姊！世界真小！那你是做哪一行的？

lines.say: Software. Marketing teams are my biggest clients. I'll put you in touch with a few.
lines.zh: 軟體。行銷團隊是我最大的客戶，我幫你介紹幾個。

lines.say: That's so kind. It was great to meet you. Let's stay in touch.
lines.zh: 你人真好。很高興認識你，我們保持聯絡。

lines.say: Well done, Giulia! Curious first, helpful second, and you followed up.
lines.zh: Giulia 做得好！先好奇，再幫忙，還記得後續聯絡。

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them before your next event.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡。下次參加活動前截圖存起來。

items: 📰 每天一則在地新聞練英文
🎮 單字小遊戲，約朋友一起玩
🔥 連續打卡、解鎖稱號、逛廣場
🎓 英文小教室：會話、片語、文法

lines.say: Before you go! Do you want to practise English a little every day?
lines.zh: 走之前！想每天都練一點英文嗎？

lines.say: Try BinBin. Every day, there's a short news story from where you live, with the hard words explained.
lines.zh: 試試 BinBin。每天一則你所在地區的短新聞，難的單字都有解釋。

lines.say: Then play quick word games, on your own or with your friends.
lines.zh: 接著玩快速的單字小遊戲，自己玩或約朋友一起。

lines.say: Keep your streak going, unlock new titles, and say hi to other learners in the plaza.
lines.zh: 保持連續打卡、解鎖新稱號，還能在廣場跟其他學習者打招呼。

lines.say: And there are more lessons like this one, right inside the app.
lines.zh: App 裡還有更多像這樣的英文小教室。

lines.say: Go to binbindaily dot com, or tap the link below.
lines.zh: 上 binbindaily.com，或點下面的連結。
lines.cap: Go to binbindaily.com, or tap the link below.

lines.say: Then you'll always have something interesting to talk about. See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 這樣你永遠有有趣的話題可以聊。下一課見，Bye！
